pages.text: $(4)Akaishi Satiation Charm$(0) (charm slot, 500k buffer): when saturation drops below 5 it restores +0.1 every tick. The food supply, in trinket form.

$(4)Akaishi Antidote Bracelet$(0) (bracelet slot, 200k buffer): instantly cures poison, $(4)500 energy per use$(0).$(br2)$(bold)Akaishi Wither Charm$(0) (belt slot, 200k buffer): instantly cures wither, $(4)1000 energy per use$(0).$(br2)Between them they chew through the nastiest debuffs the moment they land.
Shared mechanics and the slot map live in the $(l:akaishi:curios)Akaishi Trinkets$(/l) overview; the battery that keeps them going is the $(l:akaishi:portable_cell)Portable Cell$(/l).
